content: {"episode_id":"ep-05019","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, denied under CO-197 for missing prior authorization. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack and a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture arrhythmic burden and correlate rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies."}
